name: Saionji Kintsune
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 96); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1244.

poems.title: This snow is not from blossoms white
poems.author: Saionji Kintsune
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 96
poems.text:
This snow is not from blossoms white
Wind-scattered, here and there,
That whiten all my garden paths
And leave the branches bare;
’Tis age that snows my hair!
